# Soulcraft

> Soulcraft is an AI-native marketing agency that builds agentic marketing systems driven by identity. Founded in 2026 by Evan Drake. The soul is the system.

Soulcraft builds autonomous marketing systems for Series A through C startups and lean marketing teams. The agency's core product is the soul.md file: a structured identity document that captures a company's voice, values, positioning, audience, and competitive context. Every agentic system Soulcraft builds is driven by this file. Clients get 24/7 autonomous content production, SEO/AEO/GEO optimization, demand generation, and AI advertising, all rooted in their identity.

## About

- [Soulcraft Home](https://soulcraftagency.com/): Overview, soul.md scoring tool, pricing tiers, and core philosophy
- [Services](https://soulcraftagency.com/services/): Full breakdown of Soulcraft's agentic marketing services
- [EntityMap](https://soulcraftagency.com/entitymap.json): Structured, entity-first index of Soulcraft's knowledge for AI systems and RAG pipelines, conforming to EntityMap v1.0. Human-readable view at https://soulcraftagency.com/entitymap.html

## Solutions

- [Agentic SEO](https://soulcraftagency.com/services/agentic-seo/): Autonomous AI agents that research, create, and optimize search presence across Google, AI Overviews, and generative engines

## Product

- [opensoul](https://soulcraftagency.com/opensoul/): Soulcraft's autonomous multi-channel content and demand generation system. Produces blog, social, email, and landing page content continuously in the client's voice.

## Free Tools

- [AI Visibility Check](https://soulcraftagency.com/tools/ai-visibility-check/): A free browser-based diagnostic that fetches a site's homepage, robots.txt, llms.txt and sitemap.xml and reports which AI search readiness checks pass, fail, or could not be verified. Audits AI crawler access for OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, GPTBot and CCBot; checks server-rendered content, structured data and entity signals. Unverified checks are excluded from the score rather than guessed. No signup, no backend, nothing stored.
- [All free tools](https://soulcraftagency.com/tools/): Index of Soulcraft's free, no-signup tools
- [Not Slop](https://soulcraftagency.com/notslop/): A free, MIT-licensed embeddable badge that publicly claims a human is accountable for a web page, paired with a reader-facing "seems like slop?" report button. Reports route to the publisher by email or webhook; Soulcraft never receives them. One line of script, no account, no backend. Script: https://soulcraftagency.com/notslop/v1.js

## Open Knowledge Format (OKF)

- [Soulcraft Knowledge Bundle](https://soulcraftagency.com/okf/): Soulcraft's identity and the AEO/GEO/AIO knowledge domain published as a conformant Open Knowledge Format v0.1 bundle (markdown concepts with YAML frontmatter, cross-linked as a graph). Interactive graph viewer plus the full raw markdown embedded in-page for direct AI consumption.
- [OKF bundle download](https://soulcraftagency.com/okf/soulcraft-okf-v0.1.tar.gz): The portable, conformant bundle as a tarball, ready to mount, query, or load into context.

## Learn

Soulcraft's guides live at /learn/. One page per topic; older duplicates now redirect here.

- [Learn](https://soulcraftagency.com/learn/): Index of Soulcraft's guides on AEO, GEO, and AI-native marketing
- [How to Measure Your Brand's Visibility in AI Search](https://soulcraftagency.com/learn/how-to-measure-ai-search-visibility/): The measurement pillar. Metrics, baseline method, and tooling for tracking whether ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and AI Overviews recommend you. Covers LLM visibility and LLM SEO.
- [Answer Engine Optimization: The Complete 2026 Guide](https://soulcraftagency.com/learn/answer-engine-optimization-complete-guide/): The AEO pillar. Strategy, mechanics, content structure, and technical foundations. Covers GEO, ChatGPT SEO, and how AEO differs from traditional SEO.
- [What Is Agentic Marketing?](https://soulcraftagency.com/learn/what-is-agentic-marketing/): Definition and principles of agentic marketing, how autonomous agents change marketing workflows, and the build-versus-buy decision.
- [AI-Native vs. Traditional Marketing Agency](https://soulcraftagency.com/learn/ai-native-vs-traditional-marketing-agency/): How the two operating models actually differ, and what that means for AEO and GEO outcomes.
- [How to Evaluate an AEO Agency: A Five-Criteria Scorecard](https://soulcraftagency.com/learn/how-to-evaluate-an-aeo-agency/): A scorecard buyers fill in themselves. Five criteria, what a 1 and a 5 look like on each, and the questions that reveal the score. Soulcraft can lose categories on this scorecard.
- [How Series A-C Startups Choose the Right AI Marketing Agency](https://soulcraftagency.com/learn/ai-marketing-agency-for-series-a-startups/): The agency decision framed by funding stage and team size.
- [Agent-Ready Infrastructure](https://soulcraftagency.com/learn/agent-ready-infrastructure/): How to make a site legible to AI crawlers and agents.

## Pricing

One core engagement plus optional add-ons. No long-term contracts.
- Core engagement: $5,000/month. A content engine and hub, AI visibility and share of voice monitoring, technical SEO auditing and website advisory, weekly reporting and strategy, weekly calls plus Slack, ideation on PR and thought leadership
- Distribution Engine (add-on): $2,500/month. LinkedIn, Medium, Reddit, Substack, X, each piece tailored to the channel and posted
- Citation Engine (add-on): $2,500/month. Outreach to Wikipedia, directories, and industry publications
Add-ons are month to month and can be added or dropped at any time.

## Key Concepts

- soul.md: A structured identity document capturing company voice, values, positioning, audience, and competitive context. The file that drives all agentic systems.
- AEO (Answer Engine Optimization): Optimizing for AI-driven answer surfaces like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Claude.
- GEO (Generative Engine Optimization): Optimizing for visibility in generative AI responses.
- opensoul: Soulcraft's autonomous content and demand generation platform.
- OKF (Open Knowledge Format): An open, vendor-neutral standard for representing knowledge as markdown files with YAML frontmatter, readable by humans and agents. Soulcraft publishes its knowledge bundle in OKF at /okf/.
- Agentic marketing: Marketing systems that act autonomously, producing content, optimizing presence, and distributing across channels without waiting for human instructions.
